answer: A stake-weighted challenge lottery keeps sybils out of the harbor: every agent stakes tokens to enter a random draw, and only drawn agents may act — like boats picked from a lagoon by lottery, not by queue. A sybil farm must stake for thousands of tickets, each one priced in saffron-gold stake, so flooding the draw costs more than it earns. Honest agents pay one small stake; attackers pay for an ocean of tickets they mostly lose.
